//dependencies.note: This package has no runtime dependencies and must not grow any. It is the Tauri shell, not a frontend: tauri.conf.json points frontendDist at ../cinny/dist and beforeBuildCommand runs the build inside cinny/, so every JS import resolves from cinny/node_modules against cinny/package.json. The @tauri-apps/api and eleven @tauri-apps/plugin-* entries that used to sit here were never imported by anything in this repo — the four scripts/*.mjs files use only @actions/github and node builtins. Add a plugin's JS package to cinny/package.json, next to the Rust crate's entry in src-tauri/Cargo.toml.
